newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK domestic textile exports fall five pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: HK domestic textile exports fall five pct in 1996.

text.p: Hong Kong's domestic exports of textiles fell five percent to HK$43.2 billion in 1996 from the year before, the Census and Statistics Department said on Friday.
Domestic exports of consumer electrical and electronic products fell by 18 percent to HK$25.9 billion last year.
Machinery, equipment, apparatus, parts and components fell eight percent to HK$36.5 billion.
Apparel was down five percent to HK$40.0 billion.
The four major industries accounted for 69 percent of Hong Kong's total domestic exports of manufactured goods in 1996, the department said.
